verdict.rationale: Importing Terraform code and state is a fair question for an infrastructure-as-code control plane like Crossplane, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no tool or workflow for converting Terraform configurations or adopting Terraform state. Community comments only describe running Crossplane alongside Terraform, which is not a migration path.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can migrate an existing Terraform-format codebase and its state into this tool
